Her expression is calm and slightly mischievous as she looks directly into the lens. [Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the shot cuts to a close-up of her hands tilting the glass to her lips; she sips the drink, lowering the empty glass back to her lap with a delicate wrist movement. widgets_values:
# Image / first-last-frame video - PDD Acc

## Purpose
Animate an input image, with an optional last frame to guide the ending.

## Use
1. Load the starting image and, if used, the last frame.
2. Describe the action, camera motion and desired audio.
3. Set output size, duration and seed, then run and review the result.

Workflow: PDD-Acc-fl2v-pod.json
